description_en: Adds protected IP addresses to an Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 为DDoS原生防护实例添加防护对象IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp add-ip --ip-list '[{"ip":"121.41.XX.XX"},{"ip":"121.42.XX.XX"}]' --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-npk1z7t90000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddIp

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses to add to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance for protection. The list is represented in a character string format converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a structure that contains the following fields:

ip: String | Required | The IP address to add.

member_uid: String | Optional | The member accounts to which the asset belongs. This field is required only when you add an asset under member accounts. Example: [{"ip":"121.41.XX.XX","member_uid":"120100811162****"}]
parameters.help_zh:
要添加到原生防护实例进行防护的IP地址列表。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：

ip：String类型 | 必选 | 要添加的IP地址。

member_uid：String类型 | 可选 | 资产所属的成员账号，仅当添加成员账号下的资产时需要输入本字段。例如：[{\"ip\":\"121.41.XX.XX\",\"member_uid\":\"120100811162****\"}]
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query instance IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的原生防护实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有原生防护实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query all regions supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. Default value: empty, which indicates the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id
